steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Accurate written description requires precise dance terminology, not everyday language | Key Fact: Movement description should cover action, dynamics, space and relationships (A D S R) | Key Fact: Action vocabulary includes actions of the body: turn, jump, travel, gesture, fall, stillness | Key Fact: Dynamics describe how movements are performed: fast, slow, sustained, sudden, heavy, light

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from describing dance in writing, and one past-paper question.
